title: The Suborned | Social Infiltration Gameplay & AI Game Development Pipeline
description:
Officers close in. Rivals want the same prize. Or you could move one person.

The Suborned is a single-player squad tactics and social infiltration game set in a bright retro-future city. Command a cell of four, learn what people need, and use their relationships and routines to plan an extraction. Make the city do the work.

Play the macOS demo: https://codecoded.itch.io/the-suborned
Source and pipeline evidence: https://github.com/codecoded/suborned/tree/assignment-07/courses/a07-complete-ai-dev-pipeline
One-page pipeline audit: https://github.com/codecoded/suborned/blob/assignment-07/courses/a07-complete-ai-dev-pipeline/audit.pdf
Detailed recorded execution: https://youtu.be/725LKDmVNQ8

CHAPTERS
0:00 Officers and rival crews
0:12 Inez, Arthur and the social route
0:35 From game design to the development pipeline
0:48 Recorded generation replay and Unity integration
1:05 Actual costs and checks before critique
1:19 Reproducibility, reflection and links

BEHIND THE GAME
Design and briefs guide specialist agent work, automated checks and human review. Approved content is integrated into Unity, playtested, packaged and released. This film follows one costed example: cast data expands into 130 people and 222 directed relationship links, with needs and routines that function in the player. No AI model runs during gameplay.

Sky Rumsey | Assignment 7: Complete AI Dev Pipeline | Engine: Unity

EVIDENCE AND SCOPE
Actual player captures and actual recorded CLI excerpts, at their captured speed. Opening officer and rival fights are separate moments from the ordinary seed-3 loud route in release build 0.2.232; no actors were spawned or rules overridden for these shots.

The AI responses are archived r016 output, replayed rather than generated live. The people demonstration stages current-plan data into the retained 0.2.232 player binary. Four mission profiles match production; some background people differ after the city remap. No fresh Unity compilation is claimed. Gameplay sources are 1080p at 20 fps, upscaled for 4K delivery.

The $0.6905 people-run cost is recorded Claude subscription usage value, not an extra API payment or the whole game's budget. Before/after critic-gating examples involve different candidates; no like-for-like percentage saving is claimed. The public two-minute visit-to-play test remains open.

MUSIC / AI DISCLOSURE
The game's lounge-spy sketch was generated with ACE-Step for this project, crossfaded and mixed as an editorial soundtrack. It is not recorded gameplay audio. Music provenance: https://github.com/codecoded/suborned/blob/assignment-07/briefs/087/licences/generated.md
